movie:10064.overview: In the troubled city of Edison, a young journalist, his jaded editor, and an honest investigator from the district attorney's office join forces to gather evidence against corrupt members of an elite police unit.
movie:10064.tagline: In this city, only the cops are above the law.
movie:10064.title: Edison

movie:10264.overview: Hamlet, Prince of Denmark, finds out that his uncle Claudius killed his father to obtain the throne, and plans revenge.
movie:10264.tagline: The extraordinary adaptation of Shakespeare's classic tale of vengeance and tragedy.
movie:10264.title: Hamlet

movie:10364.overview: A WWII military pilot makes a valiant effort to be certified insane in order to be excused from flying missions. But there's a catch.
movie:10364.tagline: The nice thing about war is that the person who kills you really has nothing against you. Personally.
movie:10364.title: Catch-22

movie:10464.overview: When Manny Singer's wife dies, his young daughter Molly becomes mute and withdrawn. To help cope with looking after Molly, he hires sassy housekeeper Corrina Washington, who coaxes Molly out of her shell and shows father and daughter a whole new way of life. Manny and Corrina's friendship delights Molly and enrages the other townspeople.
movie:10464.tagline: They needed a family. What they got was magic.
movie:10464.title: Corrina, Corrina

movie:1076364.overview: Carl Fredricksen reluctantly agrees to go on a date with a lady friend—but admittedly has no idea how dating works these days. Ever the helpful friend, Dug steps in to calm Carl's pre-date jitters and offer some tried-and-true tips for making friends—if you're a dog.
movie:1076364.title: Carl's Date

movie:11564.overview: Andy is a new teacher at an inner city high school that is unlike any he has seen before. There are metal detectors at the front door and the place is basically run by a tough kid named Peter Stegman. Soon, Andy and Stegman become enemies and Stegman will stop at nothing to protect his turf and drug dealing business.
movie:11564.tagline: "We are the future! ...and nothing can stop us."
movie:11564.title: Class of 1984

movie:1318864.overview: September 1940. Henri Marre arrives alone in Vichy as the authoritarian regime settles in. Broke, estranged from his family, and carrying copies of his self-published manifesto Notre Salut (Our Salvation), the 49-year-old is determined to secure what he believes is his rightful place in the new administration. In his writing, Henri sets out his patriotic convictions and his engineer’s methodology: efficiency above all. Claiming he wants to help save France after defeat, he does whatever is required to remain useful, serving the machinery of the new order with increasing skill. But he may be pursuing something more urgent: escape from his own ruin
movie:1318864.title: A Man of His Time

movie:1397364.overview: As his tenure as President of Italy nears its end, Mariano De Santis faces wrenching decisions-both political and deeply personal. Amid these moral quandaries, he must confront his own conscience and seek guidance from those closest to him, including his confidante and daughter, Dorotea.
movie:1397364.tagline: A president. A pardon. A legacy.
movie:1397364.title: La Grazia

movie:1426964.overview: As São Paulo erupts in an unprecedented wave of violence, a lawyer with underworld ties must strike a deal with the police to rescue her kidnapped niece.
movie:1426964.title: State of Fear

movie:1469164.overview: A prodigal daughter rejoins her family at their farm during a difficult time, as her ailing father faces both a terminal diagnosis and mounting pressure from competitors. Old wounds resurface as they grapple with what lies ahead.
movie:1469164.title: Casa Grande

movie:1487864.overview: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.
movie:1487864.title: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film

movie:1633264.overview: With rare access and no holds barred, the acclaimed documentarian investigates a growing ultra-masculine network and its controversial influencers.
movie:1633264.title: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere

movie:1645164.overview: Paolo Marra killed his wife for no reason. Consumed by guilt, he decides to turn himself in: he wants to pay the price, serve his sentence, and restore dignity to the woman he killed—and to himself. Amid distracted police officers, zealous lawyers, fortune-tellers, and complicated bureaucratic red tape, no one takes him seriously. The man finds himself the victim of a Kafkaesque paradox: no matter how much he wants it, he cannot get himself arrested. He is the perfect scapegoat for a grotesque society that ignores those who seek redemption.
movie:1645164.title: Snake

movie:1668364.overview: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.
movie:1668364.title: Desire

movie:17264.overview: While traveling with his father, young Alec becomes fascinated by a mysterious Arabian stallion that is brought on board and stabled in the ship he is sailing on. When it tragically sinks both he and the horse survive only to be stranded on a deserted island. He befriends it, so when finally rescued both return to his home where they soon meet Henry Dailey, a once successful trainer. Together they begin training the horse to race against the fastest ones in the world.
movie:17264.tagline: From the moment he first saw the stallion, he knew it would either destroy him, or carry him where no one had ever been before…
movie:17264.title: The Black Stallion

movie:18764.overview: Identical twins are separated at birth, one becoming a streetwise mechanic, and the other an acclaimed classical concert conductor. Finally meeting in adulthood, they're mistaken for the other and entangled in each other's worlds.

providers.name: Best of British Tv Amazon Channel

providers_wtw.name: Best of British Tv Amazon Channel

movie:18764.title: Twin Dragons

movie:19064.overview: Mark wants to lose his virginity, but his girlfriend wants to wait. Unfortunately for both of them, a 400-year-old vampire Countess needs to turn a virgin into a vampire before Halloween in order to preserve her own youthful appearance, and when she finds Mark, she turns his life upside-down.
movie:19064.tagline: Mark Kendall just found out his one-night stand has been around for centuries.
movie:19064.title: Once Bitten

movie:19164.overview: When Littlefoot's grandfather falls ill, the only way to cure him is with a flower from the forbidding land of the mists, which holds unexpected perils and danger.
movie:19164.tagline: Bring home littefoot's brand new, feature length adventure!
movie:19164.title: The Land Before Time IV: Journey Through the Mists

movie:27064.overview: A fictional account of the life of Japanese author Yukio Mishima, combining dramatizations of three of his novels and a depiction of the events of November 25th, 1970.
movie:27064.tagline: On November 25, 1970, Japan's most celebrated writer, Yukio Mishima, shocked the world.
movie:27064.title: Mishima: A Life in Four Chapters

trailer.name: AFS Presents: Mishima A Life in Four Chapters

movie:283564.overview: A new member has joined Eli and the Shane Gang! Junjie, once the protector of the Eastern Caverns, is a master of the slugslinging art of Slug Fu! But even with the power of five slingers, the Shane Gang find themselves in over their heads as they race across The 99 Caverns in search of the Legendary Elemental Slugs. The five Elementals are ancient slugs of great power, and the forbearers of all slugs found in SlugTerra today. In the wrong hands, they could bring Slugterra to the brink of destruction. So when an evil alliance starts hunting down the Elementals, Eli and his friends — old and new — take off in pursuit of the greatest threat their world has ever faced!
movie:283564.title: SlugTerra: Return of the Elementals

movie:291264.overview: A brother and sister return to their family home in search of their world famous parents who have disappeared.
movie:291264.title: The Family Fang

movie:351964.overview: Desperate for a good story, a sex-addicted journalist throws himself into the world of high-class escorts when he starts following a Stanford-educated prostitute.
movie:351964.title: The Escort

movie:370964.overview: In the midst of the wedding princess Miroslava is kidnapped by a dragon and carried away into his castle on the remote island. Mira left everything behind in the past - family, friends and groom. Now the only things she had were a stone cage and a mysterious young man named Arman ... but who is he and what is he doing on that island? Miroslava will know the truth too late: loving a dragon will reveal the bitter truth - love is scary.
movie:370964.title: I Am Dragon

movie:384664.overview: Maik, a fourteen-year-old teenager, sets out on a road trip during summertime with Tschick, a new classmate, in a stolen car. The two share life changing experiences during the eventful journey.
movie:384664.title: Goodbye Berlin

movie:41664.overview: After thirty years in the big corporation, Ugo Fantozzi retires. Suddenly, he needs things to do in everyday life and he tries a number of activities: helping Pina shopping; babysitting grand-daughter Uga; a trip to Venice; learning golf. He then fakes documents to get a new job, but in the end he becomes a hypochondriac and doesn't even take a long-awaited chance with Miss Silvani.
movie:41664.title: Fantozzi Retires

movie:476764.overview: Gary Hart, former Senator of Colorado, becomes the front-runner for the Democratic presidential nomination in 1987. Hart's intelligence, charisma and idealism makes him popular with young voters, leaving him with a seemingly clear path to the White House. All that comes crashing down when allegations of an extramarital affair surface in the media, forcing the candidate to address a scandal that threatens to derail his campaign and personal life.
movie:476764.tagline: Gary Hart was going to be President. Instead he changed American politics forever.
movie:476764.title: The Front Runner

movie:49964.overview: An 8-year-old boy must return his friend's notebook he took by mistake, lest his friend be punished by expulsion from school.
movie:49964.title: Where Is The Friend's House?

movie:508664.overview: Vietnam War, 1966. Australia and New Zealand send troops to support the United States and South Vietnamese in their fight against the communist North. Soldiers are very young men, recruits and volunteers who have never been involved in a combat. On August 18th, members of Delta Company will face the true horror of a ruthless battle among the trees of a rubber plantation called Long Tân. They are barely a hundred. The enemy is a human wave ready to destroy them.
movie:508664.tagline: Outnumbered. Outgunned. Never out of courage.
movie:508664.title: Danger Close: The Battle of Long Tan

movie:517764.overview: The young couple Nora and Alec are on their way back from a long road trip. In a  desert town they want to take a break, but when they wake up the next morning, they are no longer in the motel where they had actually checked in. Overnight, the by a group of crazed killers wearing animal masks, have been abducted.  What would happen if people were treated like cattle for slaughter? On the farm, this horrific idea comes true. As Nora and Alec soon find out, they are not the only ones locked in cages, fattened up and fed only to be slaughtered, disemboweled and eaten as a delicacy by their torturers. For the young couple begins a fight for bare survival.
movie:517764.title: The Farm

movie:573164.overview: Toto and his friends must rescue his egg children after they're taken away for a gourmet food event in Africa.
movie:573164.title: An Egg Rescue

movie:669664.overview: Antoinette, a school teacher, is looking forward to her long planned summer holidays with her secret lover Vladimir, the father of one of her pupils. When learning that Vladimir cannot come because his wife organized a surprise trekking holiday in the Cévennes National Park with their daughter and a donkey to carry their load, Antoinette decides to follow their track, by herself, with Patrick, a protective donkey.
movie:669664.title: My Donkey, My Lover & I

movie:830764.overview: In 1969, young Jud Crandall has dreams of leaving his hometown behind, but soon discovers sinister secrets buried within and is forced to confront a dark family history that forever binds him to Ludlow.
movie:830764.title: Pet Sematary: Bloodlines

movie:840464.overview: Having found the safety of the Greenland bunker after the comet Clarke decimated the Earth, the Garrity family must now risk everything to embark on a perilous journey across the wasteland of Europe to find a new home.
movie:840464.title: Greenland 2: Migration

movie:871964.overview: When something horrible happens to the only survivor of a bloody massacre, an insecure rookie cop must overcome his fears to stop further carnage.
movie:871964.title: Nobody Sleeps in the Woods Tonight 2

movie:9264.overview: A seductive teen befriends an introverted high school student and schemes her way into the lives of her wealthy family.
movie:9264.tagline: Ivy thought her best friend had the perfect house, the perfect family, the perfect life. So she took them.
movie:9264.title: Poison Ivy

movie:964.overview: The deformed Phantom who haunts the Paris Opera House causes murder and mayhem in an attempt to make the woman he loves a star.
movie:964.tagline: The greatest horror film of modern cinema!
movie:964.title: The Phantom of the Opera

trailer.name: The Phantom of the Opera (1925) - Original trailer

movie:973164.overview: With his signature pitch-black sense of humor, Ricky Gervais takes the stage at the London Palladium in this provocative stand-up comedy special.
movie:973164.title: Ricky Gervais: SuperNature

tv:124364.overview: Unravel the mystery of a nightmarish town in middle America that traps all those who enter. As the unwilling residents fight to keep a sense of normalcy and search for a way out, they must also survive the threats of the surrounding forest – including the terrifying creatures that come out when the sun goes down.
tv:124364.tagline: Every road leads here. No road leads out.
tv:124364.title: FROM

tv:246864.overview: 25-year-old Amadeus arrives in Vienna, unemployed after his father’s death. He allies with singer Constanze Weber, who helps bring him into the orbit of court composer Salieri, igniting a rivalry that defines their legacies.
tv:246864.title: Amadeus

tv:255064.overview: Charlie is one of a kind. As a half-human, half-chimpanzee Humanzee, his intellect and physical prowess is off the charts. Which is why The Animal Liberation Alliance, a terrorist group, wants him. And they will take extreme measures to get him. However, Charlie is determined to fight back for the sake of his loved ones.
tv:255064.title: The Darwin Incident

tv:258764.overview: No Ki-jun, an employee at an insurance company, decides to develop a divorce insurance policy after personally experiencing three divorces that impacted his life and finances. Despite potential biases, he believes divorce is an unforeseen disaster and establishes a team for divorce insurance.
tv:258764.title: The Divorce Insurance

tv:297464.overview: A seemingly perfect household unravels when an unexpected visitor arrives, exposing hidden tensions and political aspirations that threaten to tear the family apart.
tv:297464.title: The Guest

tv:38464.overview: Humans live in the world of Assiah, demons in Gehenna. The two dimensions are not meant to interfere with each other, but demons still possess creatures in Assiah in spite of this. The humans who can fight these demons are known as exorcists. Rin Okumura is a boy who bears the curse of being Satan's illegitimate son. His foster father sacrificed himself to save him from demons. To avenge his foster father's death as well as to prove himself, Rin decides to follow the path of an exorcist and defeat his own father, Satan. To hone his raw skills, Rin enters True Cross Academy to train with other exorcist candidates.
tv:38464.title: Blue Exorcist

tv:4464.overview: An American police procedural chronicling the work of a fictional version of the Baltimore Police Department's Homicide Unit.
tv:4464.tagline: Homicide: our day begins when yours ends.
tv:4464.title: Homicide: Life on the Street

tv:63764.overview: The adventures of Vicenta Acero, the feared coyote who now leads the dynasty of illicit dealings once under the control of her father.
tv:63764.title: Senora Acero

tv:764.overview: The peacefulness of the Midsomer community is shattered by violent crimes, suspects are placed under suspicion, and it is up to a veteran DCI and his young sergeant to calmly and diligently eliminate the innocent and ruthlessly pursue the guilty.
tv:764.title: Midsomer Murders

tv:94664.overview: When a 34-year-old underachiever gets run over by a truck, his story doesn't end there. Reincarnated in a new world as an infant, Rudy will seize every opportunity to live the life he's always wanted. Armed with new friends, some freshly acquired magical abilities, and the courage to do the things he's always dreamed of, he's embarking on an epic adventure—with all of his past experience intact!
tv:94664.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
